notes: Real Provider smoke used py312 with the local .env and standard TLS verification enabled: post_chat_stream received SSE events, aggregated delta.content and parsed a JSON object; ProviderReranker.score_async, QueryAwareExtractor.aextract, aanswer_from_evidence and averify all returned schema-valid results.
TLS certificate chain validation succeeds with the default SSL context; OpenAI SDK, requests and urllib all return HTTP 200. TLS verification is always enabled and verify=False is rejected.

The decide_action_async instruction now requires action=search when observations is empty and forbids answering from general knowledge; the agent.py first-step-must-be-search guard is kept as a backstop and the live CLI no longer raises ValueError on the first ReAct decision.

PRE-FIX HISTORICAL NOTE: before the observation-feedback fix the travel-materials question did not reach completed (model rejected although verify had passed). After the fix the same question returns completed with 1 verified citation; see agent_e2e_clear_question and the live_react record.

Three real-provider CLI runs are recorded under examples/{requests,traces,results}/live_*.json: completed, conflict_detected, insufficient_evidence. Clear-case previously failed because the ReAct observation omitted the verified answer and evidence quotes; the fix only completed that information flow.
Offline accuracy metrics below remain from the local deterministic pipeline; the three live runs are single observations, not a systematic online accuracy evaluation.

status_accuracy.definition: Fraction of cases whose returned status matches the expected status (completed, conflict_detected, or insufficient_evidence).

query_retrieval_exact_accuracy.definition: Fraction of questions where the set of cited document IDs exactly equals the expected evidence document set. Penalizes both missed evidence and irrelevant extra documents.

document_precision_macro.definition: For each question, relevant cited documents divided by all cited documents; then averaged across questions. Measures citation noise.

document_recall_macro.definition: For each question, retrieved relevant documents divided by all expected relevant documents; then averaged. Empty expected sets receive 1 only when no documents are cited.

document_f1_macro.definition: Harmonic mean of per-question document precision and recall, averaged across questions.

answer_exact_match.definition: For answerable cases only, exact string match between generated answer and the reference answer grounded in the local source chunk.

correct_abstention_accuracy.definition: For conflict or unanswerable cases, verifies the expected non-answer status and that no answer text was emitted.
